Resolves #21066

🧭 Reconciles `Neo.menu.List` with the shared `.neo-floating` (`1000`) layer and DOM-order stacking model (`Neo.dialog.Base` + `Neo.main.DomAccess#syncModalMask`). `Menu.List#zIndex_` defaults to `null` instead of writing an inline `z-index: 100` override, and `Menu.List#showSubMenu` roots submenus in `me.floating ? me.parentId : 'document.body'` so unoverridden floating menus and submenus mount after their owning dialog at `1000` without defeating a later foreground modal mask, while explicit `menu: {zIndex}` overrides still cascade `+ 1` per submenu level across creation, hide/reopen, and runtime updates.

Evidence: L3 (whitebox Playwright E2E in real Chrome against `examples/grid/issues` and `examples/dialog`, red on `dev` `2fff9b352c` and green on this head, plus unit and component suites) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-5).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` ("AC-1") mounts a `Neo.grid.Container` with `searchToolbar` inside a non-modal `Neo.dialog.Base` on `examples/grid/issues` and asserts `BODY` portal mount, `zIndex === '1000'`, DOM order following the dialog, `menu.contains(document.elementFromPoint(x, y)) === true`, and real pointer scope selection (`Title`). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` ("AC-2 & AC-3"), `test/playwright/unit/menu/List.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/component/menu/` exercise body-level and dialog-hosted button menus, root/submenu DOM order and hit testing, interactive focus-capture dismissal on modal open, and foreground `.neo-dialog-modal-mask` dominance over unfocused background menus/submenus. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` ("AC-2 & AC-3") and `unit/menu/List.spec.mjs` ("leaves zIndex null by default...") assert explicit `menu: {zIndex: 1500}` (`1501` on submenu) across hide/reopen and runtime `zIndex` updates across cached `subMenuMap` levels. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` ("AC-4") and `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/{CloseFocus,MoveResize,OpenFocus}.spec.mjs` verify three nested modal dialogs on `examples/dialog` (`ComboBox` picker at `1000` owning hit testing, Picker `Escape` keeping all 3 modals open, `Tab` focus wrapping inside `Dialog 3`, mask re-anchoring/teardown across header close + `Escape`, and clean reopen). |
| AC-5 | CI-covered + outside-CI receipt below: `MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` failed AC-1 and AC-2 on unpatched `dev` (`2fff9b352c`, `zIndex: 100` vs `1000`) while passing AC-4, and passes 3/3 on this branch. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **Submenu portal alignment (`src/menu/List.mjs:964`):** `showSubMenu()` now passes `parentId: me.floating ? me.parentId : 'document.body'` instead of `me.app.mainView.id`. Once unoverridden menus share `1000` with `Dialog` and `.neo-dialog-modal-mask` instead of escalating inline numbers, mounting a submenu inside `mainView` (which precedes `document.body`-rooted dialogs in DOM order) would paint the submenu behind its owning dialog; matching the floating portal keeps root and submenu cascades ordered after their dialog while preserving `component/menu/List.spec.mjs`'s custom viewport `parentId`.
- **Base dialog mask cleanup already resolved upstream:** The destroyed/closing dialog mask cleanup noted in the ticket body landed in #21417 and #21433 and passes cleanly in `MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` AC-4 and `CloseFocus.spec.mjs`.
- **Structural Pre-Flight:** `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MenuLayerNL.spec.mjs` matches sibling pattern of `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/CloseFocus.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/grid/SearchToolbarNL.spec.mjs` (registered in `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS`).

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:**

*   **Expected Solution Shape:** Drop the inline 100 so an unoverridden menu shares the floating layer with dialogs and stacks by DOM order. A submenu should share its root's portal, so the cascade stays ordered after the owning dialog. An explicit `zIndex` must keep cascading `+1` per level. It must not hardcode an ancestor's z-index. Test isolation: a real-browser arm that reds on `dev`, plus a unit arm for the cascade and its reset to `null`.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `zIndex_: null` with a guarded `afterSetZIndex`: the first `null` writes nothing, and a later `null` clears the inline style and the cached submenus. `showSubMenu` passes `me.floating ? me.parentId : 'document.body'`, plus `theme: me.theme`, so a submenu moved to the body keeps its theme. The unit arm covers 1500 → 1501 → 1502 and the reset.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with friction→gold: the layer model #21066 traced back to the 2023 floating work is reused, not replaced.
